This test validates whether a user can successfully access the Barclays Appian Test environment (barclayinttest.appiancloud.com) from a personal device using Federation SSO – SAML Authentication.

When user tries to access the barclayinttest.appiancloud.com from personal device, User will be redirected to Barclays Authenticator page.

Evidence:

Step 2: User enters credentials and RSA token

Action: Provide Valid Credentials in Barclays Authenticator Page.

Expected Result: User should not be able to access the Barclays Assure Appian Test site from personal device.

Actual Result: Users are not allowed to access the Appian test environment from personal devices because external authentication is disabled by Federation SSO.

Evidence:

  • Differences in the operation or frequency of the control to the legal entity
  • Impact of CE or audit issues that LE Service Recipient should be aware of

Also include commentary where the relevance of the audit opinion differs across legal entities.

  • The critical issues raised in this audit have similar significance to both BBPLC and BBUKPLC.
  • The issues in this audit predominantly impact BBPLC, due to the mitigating controls in place in BBUKPLC.
  • The issues in this audit impact the availability of systems used for retail customer processes, so have greater impact on BBUKPLC than BBPLC.
  • BBPLC represents 80% of risk limits covered in this audit, BBUKPLC represents 20%
